title: Reply: AST covers attention, an in-the-moment model, beliefs and output

statements.text: AST is not only a theory of a folk belief. It includes changing attention, an automatic moment-by-moment model of it, beliefs drawn from that model and their output, and it explains attention control and the modeling of others as well as the claim to experience.

sources.locator: A Theory of Consciousness that Embodies Principles 1 and 2
sources.quote: A common misunderstanding about AST is that it merely explains how people have a general, cognitive belief in a nonphysical mind
Yes, AST explains why we believe we have consciousness, but to insist only on that facet of AST misses the bigger picture.
